scene_description: A family of four is camping outdoors in a wooded area. Three children and one adult are sitting in camp chairs around a round fire pit with a fire burning inside. One child is holding a stick over the fire, likely roasting a marshmallow. A green tent and blue camp chairs are visible in the background.
